gates.name: no-hardcoded-tokens
gates.description: No hex colour literal outside src/styles/tokens.css. No hard-coded font-family string outside tokens.css.

gates.name: no-founding-date
gates.description: No founding date, company age, headcount or 'newly established' language anywhere in copy or structured data.
gates.pattern: (founded in|founded [0-9]|established (in )?20|since 20|newly established|young company|new company|years of experience|years in business|foundingDate|numberOfEmployees)

gates.name: no-banned-words
gates.description: Banned marketing words and constructions per the copy rules.
gates.pattern: (empowering|(^|[^-])transforming|unlocking|seamless|cutting-edge|revolutionary|world-class|best-in-class|one-stop|Welcome to|Why choose us|at scale|empower|(^|[^-])transform([a-z]|[ 	]+[a-zA-Z])|unlock|state-of-the-art|game-chang|leverage our|passionate about|committed to excellence|industry-leading)

gates.name: no-forbidden-ui
gates.description: No gradients, no backdrop-filter. Shadows and radii only via the --shadow-* / --radius-* tokens, never ad-hoc values.

gates.name: wordmark-case
gates.description: The wordmark is never all-caps and never two-tone. Guards the exact failure the owner flagged.

gates.name: no-placeholder-copy
gates.description: No lorem ipsum, no TODO left in shipped source, no 'coming soon', no stub text, no stray PLACEHOLDER_DO_NOT_KEEP-style marker.
gates.pattern: (lorem ipsum|coming soon|placeholder text|TODO\(session|built in a later session|TBD|PLACEHOLDER[_ ]?DO[_ ]?NOT[_ ]?KEEP)

gates.name: no-prices
gates.description: No prices anywhere on the site. Every commercial path ends in a quotation request.
